103:  *
104:  */
105: public class DefaultResizerFactory implements ResizerFactory {
106: 	private static final DefaultResizerFactory INSTANCE = new DefaultResizerFactory();
107: 
108: 	/**
109: 	 * This class is not intended to be instantiated via the constructor.
110: 	 */
111: 	private DefaultResizerFactory() {}
112: 	
113: 	/**
114: 	 * Returns an instance of this class.
115: 	 * 
116: 	 * @return		An instance of this class.
117: 	 */
118: 	public static ResizerFactory getInstance() {
119: 		return INSTANCE;
120: 	}
121: 	
122: 	public Resizer getResizer() {
123: 		return Resizers.PROGRESSIVE;
124: 	}
125: 	
126: 	public Resizer getResizer(Dimension originalSize, Dimension thumbnailSize) {
127: 		int origWidth = originalSize.width;
128: 		int origHeight = originalSize.height;
129: 		int thumbWidth = thumbnailSize.width;
130: 		int thumbHeight = thumbnailSize.height;
131: 		
132: 		if (thumbWidth < origWidth && thumbHeight < origHeight) {
133: 			if (thumbWidth < (origWidth / 2) && thumbHeight < (origHeight / 2)) {
134: 				return Resizers.PROGRESSIVE;
135: 			} else {
136: 				return Resizers.BILINEAR;
137: 			}
138: 		}
139: 		else if (thumbWidth > origWidth && thumbHeight > origHeight) {
140: 			return Resizers.BICUBIC;
141: 		} else if (thumbWidth == origWidth && thumbHeight == origHeight) {
142: 			return Resizers.NULL;
143: 		} else {
144: 			return getResizer();
145: 		}
146: 	}
147: }
